notes:
Seti Astro Suite Pro

V1.19.12
Major Overhaul of Mosaic Master to perform full SIP distortion correction and reprojection in the celestial sphere utilizing up to 4th order poly pixel placement. Mosaic smart builds following greedy overlap algorithms for large mosaics. Star Alignment superseded by the SIP distortion placement algorithms. Background normalization improved dramatically. Gradients still need to be removed prior to running mosaic master.

Major overhaul of Hyperbolic Stretch and Curves.

New file format support: WEBP

Other minor bug fixes.
